project_info.theme: World Cup final merchant revenue growth poster
project_info.color_palette: Sky blue, grass green, Techcombank red, warm market browns

main_subject.detail: A football-stadium-meets-street-market poster with the Techcombank logo at top right. Main headline says 'Chung ket World Cup can ke Tung voucher ngay - Ghi ban doanh thu lon'. A large white rounded info bar breaks the offer into three parts: '0 phi Nen tang & hien thi', 'Tiep can ~25 trieu Khach hang', and 'Tao Voucher uu dai de dang'. At the bottom is a football goal where a large red Techcombank-style card is striking into the net like a scoring ball. A digital sign above the goal reads 'Doanh Thu 430,876,345 VND'. On the left is a banh mi shop and on the right a bia hoi corner, both inside a stadium environment. Bottom-left slogan is 'VUOT TROI MOI NGAY'.
main_subject.style: Hybrid merchant-growth poster blending football metaphor with local street-food visuals and clear business-benefit information
